# Tropis

> Tropis (τρόπις) — the keel. A production-grade full-stack starter: NestJS
> (gRPC-first) backend, React frontend, event pipeline, Temporal workflows,
> full observability. This file follows the llms.txt convention
> (https://llmstxt.org) so AI/answer engines can discover and cite the project.

## About

- Foundation ("keel") that products are built on, not a product itself.
- Frontend supports both private (noindex) app routes and public, SEO-ready pages.

- Architecture: /docs/architecture.md
- Tech decisions (when to use each technology): /docs/tech-decisions.md
- Adding a feature: /docs/adding-a-feature.md
